title: Your study app's free trial ends at midnight
scenario: A pop-up in a homework-help app says your free trial ends at midnight and you'll lose your saved notes unless you enter a card number right now to keep using it.

answers.A: Check with a parent before entering any card details, and read what happens if the trial just ends.
answers.B: Enter your own details quickly so you don't lose your notes.
answers.C: Enter a parent's card number without asking, since it's just to save your notes.

explanation: Free-trial pop-ups are designed to make losing your notes feel urgent, but a trial ending never deletes your existing account without warning - and a card decision isn't yours to make alone.
proTip: A subscription decision always waits for a parent, no matter what the countdown says.
